source_read: https://www.fireaway.co.uk/menu/<category>?store=<id> (live pages read again on 2026-10-10 at two shops NOT used by the script: Watford 150 and Inverness 92; robots.txt allows /menu and /locations)
not_verifiable: allergens: none published by us (the site shows a few icons per card; the chain's allergen matrix is a PDF on a host whose robots.txt request answers 400, not downloaded)
notes: Calories-only chain. All 62 published rows (every name, kcal and serving) were re-read from the rendered page text of two further shops with a different method from the script (visible text lines of each card instead of the data-testid markup, a different pair of shops: 124 rows compared, 0 differences). The script also sums each card's figure again from the menu feed (option kcal plus default-topping kcal, 570 cards over 8 shops, all equal) and the same name had the same kcal at all 8 shops read (Clapham, Aberdeen, Cardiff, Preston, Nottingham, Plymouth, Norwich, Harborne). Pizza figures are for the whole pizza at the size printed; the card prints no per-slice figure. Largest 1327 (Crunchy Goblin), smallest 1 (Diet Coke 330ml).
